newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht, interbank rate steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht, interbank rate steady in late trade.

text.p: The Thai baht was steady against the dollar in quiet late trade on Monday as most of the players were sidelined awaiting the government's final decision on the International Monetary Fund's rescue package, dealers said.
The baht was traded at 31.70/31.83 to the dollar near the close in the domestic market compared with 31.60/31.70 in mid-afternoon and 31.70/31.80 in the morning, dealers said.
"The market was very quiet. We are awaiting the final result of IMF package," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The dealer said there was some dollar selling by local exporters today on optimism about the baht's firming trend boosted by IMF support.
In the offshore market, the baht was traded at 31.60/31.80 in late trade against 31.55/31.65 in the morning.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was traded at 14/18 satangs per dollar late in domestic market and 14/19 satangs in offshore market.
The overnight interbank rate was at 14 percent near close, unchanged from early morning, dealers said.

"The liquidity was easing quite a bit today compared with last week. But any sharp fall in the interbank rate would be limited by some demand for funds for the upcoming reserve deadline," said one money market dealer.
All commercial banks have to meet the central bank's reserve requirement on the seventh and 22nd of every month.
